name: Anchor
overview: Scripture uses the image of an anchor both literally and figuratively to illustrate security and stability. In Acts 27, anchors are cast from a ship to prevent it from drifting onto rocks during a storm, symbolizing physical safety amid danger. Hebrews 6:19 applies this imagery spiritually, describing hope in Christ as an anchor for the soul that is sure and steadfast, providing inner security that reaches beyond this life. Together, these verses reveal that just as anchors hold a ship firm, Christ’s hope anchors believers securely through life's trials.
